title: Jest
description: A delightful JavaScript testing framework with a focus on simplicity.

data.text: Jest is a zero-configuration testing framework maintained by Meta. It ships with an assertion library, a test runner, and mocking utilities, making it a complete solution for unit and integration testing.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install Jest as a dev dependency.
data.code:
npm install --save-dev jest
# or
yarn add --dev jest

data.title: Basic Test

terms.definition: Defines a single test case in Jest.
Jest's assertion function used to validate values.
Methods like toBe, toEqual, and toThrow that compare values.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Jest requires little to no configuration
It includes built-in mocking and coverage
Widely used in React and Node.js projects
data.takeaway: Jest is a mature, batteries-included framework for testing JavaScript.
